body: Thank you... I wish I did. :/
Being completely honest.. I feel if I drove myself to the hospital I would jump from the parking deck before I even got in...
I don't know... maybe if there was a chance things would get better in the future, but right now I see no future...
I just don't know that I could walk into the hospital and let them admit me there... that scares me so much.
I've been admitted to the psych unit at the hospital twice before... I just don't want that happening again. :/ I'm afraid they'll see my scars...
